title: Independent reading: Hebrews 1:1–4
subtitle: Handle a long opening sentence with participial density.
overview: Hebrews 1:1–4 compresses a major claim into one highly structured sentence. Find the main finite verb and attach the participial descriptions one by one.
Do not lose the temporal contrast between former speech and the Son-centered speech introduced by the opening phrases.

items.grc: πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως πάλαι ὁ θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις.
items.en: In many portions and in many ways, God having spoken long ago to the fathers in the prophets.

items.grc: ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν τούτων ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν υἱῷ.
items.en: At the end of these days he spoke to us in a Son.
